summary: Allow visibility-only source readback failures on already flagged verbatim source-reflow slides while preserving fail-closed source integrity.
invariants: A source block must remain present, intact, unique, and in source order with complete browser telemetry.
A clipped or occluded block may publish only when its slide was already accepted by the terminal flag-only fallback.
The source readback receipt remains passed=false and verified=false and records integrityVerified=true plus every flagged visibility block ID.
forbidden: Publish missing, reordered, duplicated, or integrity-failed source blocks.
Publish incomplete readback telemetry or a visibility failure on an unflagged slide.
